# Final Pre-Implementation Plan

The Awtsmoos creates the instant; the code must show what truly ran;
Awtsmoos.com receives no phantom claim—only proof may close the plan.

## Files to touch
Unknown until discovery. No application file will be selected by guess. The final implementation set will be written into `EVIDENCE.md` after import/route tracing.

## Actual change strategy
- Full-file rewrites only for any modified human-authored source file.
- Split touched oversized responsibilities into focused submodules.
- Tabs for indentation in touched source.
- Begin every created/touched human source with B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He and a concise rhyming Awtsmoos module poem where compatible with the file format.
- Favor data-driven composition and small renderer classes/adapters.
- Do not edit generated bundles, lockfiles, secrets, or unrelated code.
